title: VOL-005 State Migration and Release Qualification
purpose: Make every state domain release-accountable: exact topology coverage, source-bound migration policy, mixed-version compatibility, replay idempotence, rollback/compensation, backup restore and authoritative-first recovery.

domain_qualification.mixed_version_policy: reader/writer compatibility must be rehearsed for any schema-changing release; otherwise explicit no-schema-change evidence is required
domain_qualification.rollback_policy: exact rollback or an explicitly tested compensation/restore path is mandatory before cutover
domain_qualification.migration_contract: migrated production application state
domain_qualification.backup_restore_contract: live scratch logical backup/restore rehearsal verifies document counts, canonical document digests and user index digests before derived rebuild; production backup policy remains operator/deployment controlled
